name: floorplan
description: The pinned architecture-map tool of `norn code map` (Code > Map). The tag archive is downloaded, checked against lock.json and the release's own CHECKSUMS.txt, and unpacked into <meta root>/state/tools/floorplan/<lock hash>/, never in a worktree; nothing under engine/ imports it, its scripts run as child processes and its serve.mjs never runs. Every change here is an owner approval (K20).
